question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **act**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Act**" means to take action or do something. (कार्रवाई करना या कुछ करना)

 
 
• **For example**: *The actors delivered a powerful performance during the final act of the play.*
 
 
 
• This verb is appropriate for filling in the blank because it fits with the context of the sentence.
 
• Grammatically, "act" is a verb that can be used in the present tense or the past tense.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**State**" can refer to a condition, situation, or mode of being. It can also indicate the physical condition of something or the political division of a country. (एक अवस्था, परिस्थिति या होने का ढंग यह किसी चीज़ की भौतिक स्थिति या किसी देश के राजनीतिक विभाजन का संकेत भी दे सकता है)
 
• "**Slake**" means to quench, satisfy, or satisfy one's thirst, desires, or needs. (किसी की प्यास, इच्छाओं या जरूरतों को बुझाना या तृप्त करना)
 
• "**Run**" refers to moving swiftly on foot, managing or operating something, or flowing as a liquid. (तेजी से पैदल चलना, किसी चीज का प्रबंधन या संचालन करना, या तरल पदार्थ के रूप में बहना)
